about: Every code point JavaScript's String.prototype.trim() removes, per ECMAScript: the WhiteSpace code points (TAB, VT, FF, SP, NBSP, ZWNBSP U+FEFF and every Zs) and the LineTerminator ones (LF, CR, LS U+2028, PS U+2029), as hexadecimal code points in order. The customer page drops a question whose text trim() leaves empty (studio/static/studio/app.js); the server's one blank test, studio.fable.result.blank_question, calls every text made of them blank. tests/test_question_ids.py builds this list from the ECMAScript definition and checks the server against it; tests/frontend/app.test.cjs checks that it is exactly what trim() removes and what the page drops.
